offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures piston single-engine aircraft and a single-engine personal jet for private owners, flight schools and charter operators. It also provides aircraft service, training, and support through a company-owned and authorized network.

primary_products.value: single-engine piston aircraft; single-engine personal jet; aircraft parts and avionics upgrades

primary_services.value: aircraft maintenance and service; pilot training; aircraft refurbishment and completion; aircraft ownership support programs

customer_segment.value: B2C: private owner-pilots and high-net-worth individuals buying personal aircraft; B2B: flight schools, charter and air-taxi operators, corporate owners, fleet operators

end_markets.value: general aviation; personal and business aviation; flight training; charter operations

revenue_model.value: product sales: new aircraft sold to owners and operators; service fees: maintenance, training, refurbishment, and support; product sales: replacement parts and upgrades
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds airframes from purchased engines, avionics and components, sold to owners and operators; service provider: service centers and training for Cirrus owners

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Middle East, Latin America via a global dealer network, factory in Duluth, Minnesota

specialization.value: related lines: single-engine piston aircraft, personal jet, plus service, training and parts

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: authorized regional sales centers and international distributors; direct sales: factory sales to fleet and flight school customers; own locations: company-owned service centers and training facilities
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: high: aircraft design and production require FAA type and production certification, EASA and other foreign authorities approve exports

notes: Owned by AVIC; details of service locations approximate.
